headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 21, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the offense. Harris II hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs in the win. The Cleveland Guardians edged the Detroit Tigers 4-3, with Travis Bazzana recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-1, with Kevin Kelly earning the win and Bryan Baker notching the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Victor Vodnik (Colorado Rockies) has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation. Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays) is on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 17, 2026, with a low back strain. Kyle Teel (Chicago White Sox) has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a right hamstrain strain. Lance McCullers Jr. (Houston Astros) is on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 16, 2026, with right shoulder inflammation.

Several teams have made notable roster moves. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash. The Athletics traded CF Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for LHP Jackson Nove and traded RHP Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for 2B Alika Williams.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound. Burns pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with multiple players contributing to the win. JJ Bleday, Sal Stewart, and Spencer Steer were among the Reds' impact hitters, while Alec Bohm and Brandon Marsh led the Phillies' offense.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 5-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles in their recent matchup. Gunnar Henderson and Shane Baz led the way for the Rays, while Pete Alonso and Samuel Basallo contributed for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Victor Vodnik Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rays Make Key Trade Addition**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays acquired 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock on May 19, 2026.
